title: MuJoCo 4.0 quickstart
description: Four MuJoCo sessions in about two seconds, with no model or data file: a recorded trajectory and its UPD export, the six analytic checks, a batch campaign with per-environment mass randomisation, and a two-link arm held at a pose by PINNeAPPle's own multibody tree.

metrics.name: free-fall relative error
metrics.how: validate(dt=1e-3) against z0 - g t^2 / 2 and v = -g t

metrics.name: arm hold drift
metrics.how: largest joint deviation over 0.3 s with torques from pinneapple_simulation.multibody

metrics.name: arm energy drift
metrics.how: largest change of the total energy over the same 0.3 s hold

checks.name: analytic cases (free fall, pendulum, friction, torque, spin, resting contact)
two independent engines agree (MuJoCo vs the multibody tree)

references: Todorov, Erez & Tassa, MuJoCo: A physics engine for model-based control, IROS 2012
